value.name: Bomber Command Center
value.text: While a friendly squadron with Bomber at distance 1-5 is attacking a ship, it may reroll 1 die.

value.name: Comms Net
value.text: After the Reveal Command Dial Step, you may remove 1 command token from this ship to assign a matching token to another friendly ship at distance 1-5.

value.name: Jamming Field
value.text: While a squadron at distance 1-2 is attacking or defending against a squadron, the attack is treated as obstructed.

value.name: Repair Crews
value.text: [Repair]: Instead of spending engineering points, you may discard 1 damage card from 1 friendly ship at distance 1-2.

value.name: Slicer Tools
value.text: After you execute a maneuver, you may exhaust this card to choose an enemy ship at distance 1-3. You may choose a new command on its top command dial.

value.name: Munitions Resupply
value.text: After your Reveal Command Dial step, you may exhaust this card and discard any number of concentrate fire tokens from this card to choose that many friendly ships at distance 1-5. Each chosen ship may gain 1 concentrate fire token.

source.verification: BSData Galactic Republic catalogue rev. 14 (22/01/2025 errata changes added)

value.setup: Place 5 concentrate fire tokens on this card.

value.name: Parts Resupply
value.text: After your Reveal Command Dial step, you may exhaust this card and discard any number of repair tokens from this card to choose that many friendly ships at distance 1-5. Each chosen ship may gain 1 repair token.

source.verification: BSData Galactic Republic catalogue rev. 14 (22/01/2025 errata changes added)
